hyperedges.label: Common permission guards
hyperedges.description: All API modules that call _require_company or _assert_can_read form a shared permission contract. Any endpoint touching a company-scoped resource must pass through _common guards.

hyperedges.label: SFA multi-tenant isolation cluster
hyperedges.description: _company_filter is the single tenant-scoping function for all SFA, marketing, and marketing_equipment endpoints. Any endpoint in these modules that reads or writes documents must call _company_filter to ensure company-scoped access.

hyperedges.label: Shared party ledger query
hyperedges.description: _fetch_party_ledger_rows in sales.py is the single GL query function for both customer AR ledger and supplier AP ledger. Sales calls it with party_type=Customer; purchasing calls it with party_type=Supplier.

hyperedges.label: Module access gate system
hyperedges.description: The _MODULE_ROLES map, _can_access_module function, and _user_allowed_modules together form a layered module-visibility system. Admins bypass it. Non-admins use per-user overrides or role derivation. All three dashboard endpoints check this gate.

hyperedges.label: JS API gateway pattern
hyperedges.description: All JS API modules import call() from client.js as the single HTTP transport. client.js is the only place that knows the Frappe endpoint URL format and {message} unwrapping convention.

hyperedges.label: Uzbekistan compliance integrations
hyperedges.description: EHF e-invoicing, CBU rate refresh, Asl Belgisi product marking, ARCA payment webhooks, and 1C sync form a compliance cluster specific to Uzbekistan regulatory requirements.

hyperedges.label: ERPNext core delegation cluster
hyperedges.description: Stabler wraps complex ERPNext business logic rather than reimplementing it. make_sales_invoice, make_purchase_invoice, make_return_doc, make_stock_entry, stop_unstop — these are all thin delegation calls to ERPNext controllers.

hyperedges.label: Common permission guards
hyperedges.description: All API modules that call _require_company or _assert_can_read form a shared permission contract. Any endpoint touching a company-scoped resource must pass through _common guards.

hyperedges.label: SFA multi-tenant isolation cluster
hyperedges.description: _company_filter is the single tenant-scoping function for all SFA, marketing, and marketing_equipment endpoints. Any endpoint in these modules that reads or writes documents must call _company_filter to ensure company-scoped access.

hyperedges.label: Shared party ledger query
hyperedges.description: _fetch_party_ledger_rows in sales.py is the single GL query function for both customer AR ledger and supplier AP ledger. Sales calls it with party_type=Customer; purchasing calls it with party_type=Supplier.

hyperedges.label: Module access gate system
hyperedges.description: The _MODULE_ROLES map, _can_access_module function, and _user_allowed_modules together form a layered module-visibility system. Admins bypass it. Non-admins use per-user overrides or role derivation. All three dashboard endpoints check this gate.

hyperedges.label: JS API gateway pattern
hyperedges.description: All JS API modules import call() from client.js as the single HTTP transport. client.js is the only place that knows the Frappe endpoint URL format and {message} unwrapping convention.

hyperedges.label: Uzbekistan compliance integrations
hyperedges.description: EHF e-invoicing, CBU rate refresh, Asl Belgisi product marking, ARCA payment webhooks, and 1C sync form a compliance cluster specific to Uzbekistan regulatory requirements.

hyperedges.label: ERPNext core delegation cluster
hyperedges.description: Stabler wraps complex ERPNext business logic rather than reimplementing it. make_sales_invoice, make_purchase_invoice, make_return_doc, make_stock_entry, stop_unstop — these are all thin delegation calls to ERPNext controllers.
